headline: Ocean-freight stress is ELEVATED and holding — 24.8/100; Strait of Hormuz is the lead driver, -50% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **24.8/100** (**elevated**), flat week-over-week. 3 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Strait of Hormuz**, running **34.0/day** vs a normal of **67.6/day** (-50%).
**341** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Mindoro Strait** is running **30% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$69.56/bbl** (+1.28% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$434.0M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$1.2M** cost-of-delay ($611K–$1.9M).
